note: Real responses from Bluesky's public search (https://api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.searchPosts, no account), recorded by tests/make_bluesky_fixtures.py. Each body is reduced before it is written: the one post returned (limit=1) is dropped, and so is `cursor`, which encodes that post's time, its author's DID and its record key; `hitsTotal`, the only field Blackout reads, is as received. No post, text, handle or author is committed.
